kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Inside a 'modern slavery situation' where cyber scammers are victims themselves
wire.summary: Wired 's Andy Greenberg explains how a cybercrime operation in Southeast Asia trapped computer engineers into defrauding victims of billions of dollars. Plus, he discusses the scam involving Fresh Air.

wire.title: This 'fire amoeba' pushes the limit of what's possible for complex life
wire.summary: Scientists have found a species they've named the fire amoeba, which is capable of reproducing at 145°F and continuing to move up to temperatures of 147°F — a record for complex eukaryotic life.

wire.title: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 over deadly 2019 Easter bombings
wire.summary: The Islamic State group-inspired attacks were among the deadliest in Sri Lanka's history, killing 42 foreigners.

wire.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue Trump. And, Paramount settles in massive merger lawsuit
wire.summary: CNN, MS NOW and Politico have sued Trump after the networks were suspended from the White House. And, Paramount makes concessions to resolve a lawsuit over its massive Warner Bros. Discovery merger.

wire.title: Houthis try to push deeper into western Yemen, upending life, witnesses tell NPR
wire.summary: As the U.S. conflict with Iran drags, the Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen have opened a new front, taking new territory and displacing more than 100,000 people.

wire.title: New DNA analysis adds evidence Jefferson fathered children with Sally Hemings
wire.summary: A lock of hair, 15 years of sleuthing and a 200-year-old question. In History by a Hair , Smithsonian Institution scholar Richard Kurin follows the DNA trail back to Thomas Jefferson.

wire.title: AI solved one of math's hardest problems. Humanity learned nothing (so far)
wire.summary: OpenAI beat humans to solving the Navier-Stokes problem, but mathematicians say the AI's solution isn't telling them much.

wire.title: Abortion is on the ballot again as post-Roe policies continue to evolve
wire.summary: Four states will vote on abortion-related ballot measures in November. The measures follow the Supreme Court's "Dobbs" decision, which upended federal abortion protections.

wire.title: How unarmed 911 teams are reshaping public safety in nearly 100 cities
wire.summary: Alternative response programs, where mental health clinicians respond to 911 calls instead of police, have proliferated since George Floyd's murder. What does it take to do this work well?

wire.title: The best and biggest games of September
wire.summary: From Silent Hill: Townfall to Control Resonant to Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave , we review the best new games to play as autumn begins, ahead of the titanic GTA6 release.

wire.title: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 men over deadly Easter Sunday bombings
wire.summary: Three churches and three luxury hotels were targeted in the 2019 attacks which killed 270.

wire.title: Developing El Niño becomes strongest on record weeks before expected peak
wire.summary: Scientists say the developing El Niño is now the strongest on record with weather impacts already being felt around the world.

wire.title: Eleven injured in shooting outside Turkish school
wire.summary: Footage appears to show a male in the area carrying a firearm, while officials say the attacker has been captured.

wire.title: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer asks judge to investigate juror and check his phone
wire.summary: The attorney wants the court to look at the juror's mobile phone use and answers on questionnaires.

wire.title: Top South African policeman charged with sexual offences
wire.summary: Shadrack Sibiya, who has made no comment, is alleged to have groomed a 16-year-old and raped an 18-year-old.

wire.title: Autopsy shows Hayden Panettiere died from a drug overdose
wire.summary: The death of the child star - who had fentanyl, Xanax, a muscle relaxant and antipsychotic medication in her system - was ruled an accident.
